thesis: Quality and cash conversion are well supported, but neither side values the growth needed for 43.91x earnings. In-line H1 results cannot resolve that dispute.
strongest_counterexample: Very low debt, strong margins and FCF matching profit support patient ownership of advanced-node exposure.
invalidation_conditions: Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters of operating margin below 30%.
Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive quarters of normalized EPS growth above 20% and positive FCF.
evidence_gaps: Matched EPS basis, customer concentration and dated earnings forecast.
Underlying statement periods and forward-estimate dates are not fully supplied.
decisive_factors: Strong margins, low debt and cash conversion support financial quality
Low debt and cash conversion make patient ownership more credible, but they do not reduce the earnings growth embedded in a 43.91x multiple
